1. Data Alignment

PM10 is recorded approximately hourly. Task 1 weather is recorded every 10 minutes, so weather measurements were aggregated to hourly values before comparison.

2. Main PM10 Findings

finding interpretation
Strongest PM10-weather relationship Wind gust (m/s) has the strongest same-hour Pearson relationship with PM10 (-0.404; Spearman -0.538).
Top 10% PM10 hours Top 10% PM10 hours average 31.52 ug/m3 versus 14.79 ug/m3 for other hours.
Wind profile during high PM10 Top 10% PM10 hours have mean wind speed 0.79 m/s versus 1.61 m/s for other hours.
Rain comparison Rain-recorded hours average 13.66 ug/m3 PM10, while no-rain hours average 16.75 ug/m3.
Wind-sector PM10 profile The highest mean PM10 by wind sector is NE (18.75 ug/m3).
